paragraphs: Systems & Methods, Inc. sells government payment acceptance, processing, disbursement, and customer service, and its SMART child support solution disburses child support payments for 18 states and 16 Tribal Nations. The company operates state disbursement units in 16 states, processing more than 76 million payments annually with a 99.99% accuracy rate. Calls are not outsourced, and the service model ranges from full-service customer service centers and IVR functionality to collection and disbursement information only.

A second line is prepaid debit cards: the smiONE Visa Prepaid Card reaches more than two million families in 16 states and 15 Tribes. SMART Pay takes online payments from non-custodial parents, employers, and others by credit and debit card, ACH, digital wallet, text, and cash. Kudzu is an online banking app for individuals, with no monthly or overdraft fees, a budgeting and saving toolkit, and learning courses.

A third line, SMILE, is a government accounting system that has been the financial system of record for the Georgia Department of Human Resources for more than 40 years. Since 1978 it has covered budgeting, asset management, general ledger, employee payroll, travel and leave, child welfare, auditing, and payment processing for state, local, and client funds.

quote.text: For more than 50 years, we’ve made it easier for families to access critical funds that improve the quality of their daily lives.
